inputs.text: {"scene":"A horizontal full-color photograph inside a small sandwich shop, composed from a customer's eye level. A large blackboard in a chunky reclaimed-timber frame fills the center of the frame. Its surface is faintly streaked with old chalk swirls. The board is divided into two menu columns, with every entry beginning with a small coloured chalk dot. Across the top, large white hand-lettered capitals read \"TODAY'S SANDWICHES\", underlined by a double wavy chalk line. In the left column, the first entry is in salmon-red capitals: \"THE ITALIAN - 9.50\", followed by two smaller white cursive lines reading \"prosciutto, salami, provolone,\" and \"arugula, hot peppers on ciabatta\". The second entry is in pale yellow capitals: \"TURKEY CLUB - 8.75\", followed by two white lines reading \"roast turkey, bacon, avocado,\" and \"tomato, dijon-mayo on sourdough\". The third entry is in mint green capitals: \"THE CUBANO - 10.00\", followed by underlined yellow words \"CHEF'S PICK\", a small five-pointed chalk star, and two white lines reading \"slow-roast pork, ham, swiss,\" and \"pickles, mustard on a cuban roll\". The fourth entry is in pink capitals: \"MEATBALL SUB - 9.00\", followed by two white lines reading \"house meatballs, marinara,\" and \"mozzarella, basil on a hero roll\". In the right column, the first entry is in mint green capitals: \"VEGGIE GARDEN - 8.25\", followed by two white lines reading \"roasted peppers, eggplant,\" and \"zucchini, pesto on focaccia\". The second entry is in pale orange capitals: \"SMOKED BRISKET - 11.50\", with a small yellow star above \"BRISKET\", followed by two white lines reading \"12-hr brisket, slaw, pickles,\" and \"bbq aioli on brioche\". The third entry is in pale blue capitals: \"TUNA MELT - 8.50\", followed by two white lines reading \"albacore, sharp cheddar,\" and \"red onion, dill on rye\". Beneath both columns, one pale blue line reads \"ADD: avocado +1.50 - bacon +2 - egg +1.50\". Below it, bouncy salmon-red script reads \"Ask About Today's Soup!\", followed by a small chalk drawing of a steaming bowl. A narrow reclaimed-wood shelf runs along the board's base, holding a terracotta pot of fresh basil at the left and exactly nine glass mason jars in a row, filled variously with sliced cucumbers, red peppers, yellow peppers, and green pickles; their brass lids catch the pendant light.","subjects":[{"description":"A large blackboard with a chunky reclaimed-timber frame, a surface faintly streaked with old chalk swirls, two menu columns, small coloured chalk dots, white, salmon-red, pale yellow, mint green, pink, pale orange and pale blue chalk lettering, a double wavy underline, a small five-pointed star, and a small steaming-bowl chalk drawing.
